title: Panshi world fact revision v1
description: One fact revision referenced by a WorldFactManifestV1's interactionFactRevisionIds or outcomeEvidenceRevisionIds. Extends the existing sealed-facts/v1 fact_id namespace (this repo does not replace that primitive) with the world-time and rights metadata current-mode manifests need: world_published_at, platform_received_at, observed_at, source_revision, an optional supersedes_fact_id correction link, and rights_scope. This schema is never referenced by schema.json directly — the manifest only carries ID lists; fixtures load this schema separately to validate the accompanying fact revision records.

fact_id.description: Same fact_id namespace as contracts/sealed-facts/v1 (immutable; corrections append a new fact_id with supersedes_fact_id, they never overwrite).

world_published_at.description: When the fact was published into the world (e.g. exchange/company disclosure timestamp).

platform_received_at.description: When the upstream platform received/ingested the fact. available_at = max(world_published_at, platform_received_at).

observed_at.description: When the underlying source observation occurred, per the sealed-facts v1 provenance.observed_at convention.

source_revision.description: Upstream source's own revision tag for this fact observation. Opaque to this repo.

supersedes_fact_id.description: Optional: the prior fact_id this revision corrects. The prior fact_id is never overwritten, matching the sealed-facts v1 supersedes rule.

rights_scope.description: Which allowlist(s) this revision is rights-cleared for. "interaction" or "outcome" restrict the revision to one physically separate allowlist only; "interaction_and_outcome" means the same fact revision is eligible for both, but each pipeline must still resolve it through its own list's explicit ref.
